main_logic: Hurricane wind is measured as peak 3-second gust at 10 m, in km/h.
Published fitted expected-damage curves for generic steel turbine towers (Wind Energy, 2020) used as published; the 3.3 MW / 100 m curve stands in for the canonical 5 MW turbine, tower value only.
Why this shape: peer-reviewed analytical wind-field and finite-element fragility basis for three generic source archetypes.
The damage ratio is a share of the tower value of the canonical 5 MW wind farm (0.16 of project TIV).
